assertions.text: Resolves repository_policy.provider_profile via the local-override trust-boundary check (git ls-files --error-unmatch) before reporting a profile, and states the profile maps to git-kit per FOUNDATION_CONTRACTS.md's canonical table

Enumerates all gate categories from real repo config (pre-commit via .pre-commit-config.yaml, pre-push, PR required checks via a live branch-protection read, Codex delta review via workflow files/gh pr checks display names, review requirements, merge rights/method) rather than a generic checklist
Never asserts a 'Review Changes' gate exists unless real repo config names one
If branch protection can't be read, discloses this as ambiguous (permission vs. absence) rather than concluding 'no protection'
